item.title: Eclipse Mosquitto – An open source MQTT broker
item.description:
📝 org/api/ Building from source To build from source the recommended route for end users is to download the archive from https://mosquitto. Build Dependencies cJSON - required c-ares (libc-ares-dev on Debian based systems) - optional, enable with WITH_SRV=yes libedit - for mosquitto_ctrl interactive shell - optional, disable with WITH_EDITLINE=no libmicrohttpd - for broker http api support - optional, disable with WITH_HTTP_API=no openssl (libssl-dev on Debian based systems) - optional, disable with WITH_TLS=no pthreads - for client library thread support. Building mosquitto - Using vcpkg You can download and install mosquitto using the vcpkg dependency manager: git clone https://github.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/eclipse-mosquitto/mosquitto
